info.description: One live position: name, apply button, location and the full description, straight from the recruitment system (Traffit). Keep exactly one per vacancy page — that is where the position renders.

anchor.description: DOM id / URL hash for this section (e.g. "details" → #details). Lets nav links target this section on the page.

headline.description: Optional. Leave empty and the position title from Traffit becomes the page heading — that is what we recommend, so a retitled position never needs editing here.

linkTarget.description: Where the button sends candidates. `application`: Traffit's application form (recommended — that is the form HR tracks). `advert`: the public advert page on Traffit.

buttonLabel.description: Text on the button that opens Traffit in a new tab.

buttonNote.description: Reassurance under the button (e.g. "We reply to every application"). Optional.

backLabel.description: Text on the link back to the vacancies list.

emptyState.description: Fallback copy for a position that is no longer published. In practice the page returns 404 for those, so this is only a safety net.
